narrative_arcs.title: Autumn dried persimmon strings in kitchen
narrative_arcs.summary: Peeled three firm astringent persimmons bought at market and hung them near the kitchen window with hemp string to dry in the cool autumn breeze.

milestones.note: Peeled and strung persimmons; kitchen smells like sweet peel.
Skin has formed a leathery translucent coat; gently massaged the fruit by the window.
